W1.reads: plastic-set clone > random-initialisation frozen floor (the gate)

W2.reads: wild-type holds the teacher's policy better than its rewired null (frozen clones)

W3.reads: wild-type > rewired-null three-factor from the plastic-set clone (primary)

W4.reads: three-factor from the clone > its frozen clone (the rule improves a competent start)

W5.reads: three-factor from the clone > its Hebbian clone (reward matters from a competent start)

W6.reads: PPO from the full-set clone > low-noise PPO from random weights (the warm start helps PPO)
